Analyte.description: The molecular entity a measurement quantifies, identified by its UniProtKB accession so that values from different platforms can be linked to the same protein.

Assay.description: A measurement procedure, defined by its technology and platform.

BiomarkerMeasurement.description: One biomarker value for one analyte at one visit, from a specimen (fluid or tissue) or from imaging.

assay.description: The assay that produced the value.

below_lloq.description: True when the value is below the assay's lower limit of quantification.

brain_region.description: Brain region of an imaging measurement, as an UBERON term.

measurement_type.description: Kind of quantity the value represents.

modality.description: Whether the value comes from a specimen or from imaging.

platform_probe_id.description: Platform-specific reagent identifier: a SomaScan SeqId (e.g. seq.12345.6) or an Olink assay ID (e.g. OID12345).

source.description: Identifier or name of the source dataset, file or system the record was taken from.

specimen.description: The specimen that was assayed. Absent for imaging measurements.

unit.description: Unit of the value, as a UCUM code.

value.description: Numeric value of a quantitative measurement.

visit.description: The visit at which this record was collected.
